title: 供应商资金风险分层
context: 采购＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年底，供应商逾期应付占未付总额比例、2025年到期订单行准时足量率；风险规则：逾期应付≥500000分且逾期占比>40%，或准时率<60%且≥10到期行；按应付降序。
commonError: 不能以未到期应付代替逾期应付，也不能用零代替无历史履约。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) outstanding,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 AND due_date<'2025-12-31' THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) overdue FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id), z AS (SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.outstanding,0) outstanding,COALESCE(a.overdue,0) overdue,100.0*a.overdue/NULLIF(a.outstanding,0) overdue_pct,COALESCE(b.n,0) due_lines,100.0*b.good/NULLIF(b.n,0) ontime_pct FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,outstanding outstanding_cents,overdue overdue_cents,ROUND(overdue_pct,2) overdue_pct,due_lines,ROUND(ontime_pct,2) ontime_pct FROM z WHERE (overdue>=500000 AND overdue_pct>40) OR (due_lines>=10 AND ontime_pct<60) ORDER BY outstanding DESC,supplier_id
